title: Unassuming
summary: UNASSU'MING, adjective Not assuming; not bold or forward; not making lofty pretensions; not arrogant; modest; as an unassuming youth; unassuming manners.

inlines.v: UNASSU'MING, adjective Not assuming; not bold or forward; not making lofty pretensions; not arrogant; modest; as an unassuming youth; unassuming manners.
